| 启动方式 | 参数与地图来源 | 当前区别 |
|---|---|---|
| 整套reality导航，slam=False | 实物nav2_params.yaml，经localization_launch传入；PCD由launch参数字典另传 | 本表值；默认world对应的实物地图文件缺失，需准备当前场地地图 |
| 整套simulation导航，slam=False | 仿真nav2_params.yaml，同样另传PCD | 除use_sim_time=True外，本块12项相同；默认仿真地图存在 |

| 包内独立launch | 自己写的参数字典，不读取整套YAML | num_neighbors=10，两种leaf_size均0.25，max_dist_sq=1.0，输入cloud_registered，frame与PCD默认空；不能直接当整套入口 |
afd0dd5459d22b467077cb1deaea09354b62baa9.translatedText:
| Startup method | Parameter and map sources | Current differences |
|---|---|---|
| Full reality navigation set, slam=False | Physical nav2_params.yaml, passed in via localization_launch; PCD is passed separately via the launch parameter dictionary | Values in this table; the physical map file corresponding to the default world is missing, and a map of the current site needs to be prepared |
| Full simulation navigation set, slam=False | Simulated nav2_params.yaml, likewise with PCD passed separately | Except for use_sim_time=True, the 12 items in this block are the same; the default simulation map exists |
| Full set slam=True | Enters slam_launch, does not enter localization_launch | This node does not run; the mapping output cannot be used to show that this block has been verified |
| Independent launch within the package | Self\-written parameter dictionary, does not read the full YAML set | num_neighbors=10, both types of leaf_size are 0\.25, max_dist_sq=1\.0, input cloud_registered, frame and PCD default to empty; cannot be used directly as the full entry point |
